why.text: AUDI AG is a fully owned subsidiary of Volkswagen AG, and Qatar Holding LLC, the investment arm of Qatar's sovereign wealth fund, the Qatar Investment Authority, holds 10.4% of Volkswagen's subscribed capital and 17.0% of its voting rights. So the Qatari state's money is behind Audi. Amnesty International and Human Rights Watch both report that migrant workers in Qatar continued to face labour abuses under the kafala sponsorship system in 2025 despite reforms.
